review_candidates.title: Network & Security Engineer (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Willst Du, dass Deine Arbeit eine echte Bedeutung & spürbare Auswirkung für uns als Gesellschaft hat? Hast Du Lust mit einem grossartigen Team eine sichere, digitale Zukunft aufzubauen? Das ist noch nicht alles – bei uns erwarten Dich ausserdem noch volle 14 Feiertage unabhängig vom Kanton und eine tip top Work-Life-Balance mit nur 40 Wochenarbeitsstunden. Du fühlst Dich angesprochen? Unser Team wächst stetig und wir suchen Dich als Network & Security Engineer (m/w/d) an unserem Standort Wettingen mit der Option zum mobilen Arbeiten. WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST Betrieb, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Firewall- und Security-Lösungen inklusive VPN-Technologien (Site-to-Site und Remote Access) Sicherstellung von Stabilität, Performance und Security in komplexen Multi-Vendor-Umgebungen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Security-Infrastrukturen Analyse, Troubleshooting sowie Behebung von Störungen und Durchführung von Fehleranalysen in komplexen Netzwerk- und Security-Umgebungen Unterstützung bei Security-relevanten Incidents und technischen Eskalationen Proaktive Kundenbetreuung im Managed-Service-Umfeld (remote und vor Ort) sowie technische Beratung zur Weiterentwicklung von Security-Landschaften Technische Unterstützung in Presales- und Kundenprojekten inklusive Mitwirkung bei Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer Security-Lösungen WIE DU UNS BEGEISTERST Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Netzwerk- und Security-Umfeld sowie fundierte praktische Kenntnisse mit Check Point, Fortinet und/oder Palo Alto Networks, idealerweise ergänzt durch Zertifizierungen wie CCSE, CCSM, NSE 5 oder PNCSE Erfahrung im Betrieb von Managed Security Services sowie vorteilhafte Kenntnisse im Bereich Secure Web Proxy bzw. Web Security Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit DNS-Lösungen (z. B. EfficientIP) oder Load-Balancing-Technologien (z. B. F5) Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, vorzugsweise mit Kenntnissen von ITIL-Prozessen Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln; hohe Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie und Teamfähigkeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme an Rufbereitschaften FEEL GOOD KULTUR @SITSGROUP Wertschätzung: Eine offen-herzliche, respektvolle und wertschätzende Kommunikationskultur steht bei uns an erster Stelle. Teamspirit: Es erwarten Dich spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben gepaart mit einem tollen und unterstützenden Team um Dich herum. Wir fördern nicht nur eine gesunde, sondern auch kollegiale Teamstruktur. Onboarding & Einarbeitung: Wir legen grossen Wert auf ein strukturiertes Onboarding und eine intensive Einarbeitung. Wir möchten, dass Du bei uns gut ankommst! Work-Life-Blending: Wir bieten Dir die Option auf mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit Fokus auf eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance. Perspektiven: Du erhältst vielfältige Freiräume für kreatives Arbeiten, persönliche Entwicklungsoptionen und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten – auch im Team. Corporate Benefits: Auf Dich warten interessante und zahlreiche Mitarbeiterkonditionen. Hire a Friend!: Empfehle Deinen Wunschkollegen! Unser lukratives Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm liegt uns besonders am Herzen und macht sich auch für Dich bezahlt! Modern Workplace: Du erhältst von uns eine moderne IT-Ausstattung (bspw. Firmenlaptop, Headsets, Zweitbildschirm etc.). Grossartige Unternehmenskultur: Wir pflegen eine offene Du-Kultur und feiern legendäre grössere und kleinere Teamevents! ÜBERZEUGT? SO GEHT’S WEITER Wir freuen uns über Deinen aussagekräftigen CV, den Du über das untenstehende Formular hochladen kannst. Ein Anschreiben darfst Du gerne weglassen. Solltest Du uns noch weitere Dokumente zur Verfügung stellen wollen, kannst Du sie in diesem Feld einfügen. Wir freuen uns sehr Dich kennenzulernen! DU WILLST NOCH MEHR ÜBER UNS WISSEN ? Mit über 700 Mitarbeitenden vereint die SITS Group Erfahrung, Kompetenz, Ressourcen und Services hochkarätiger IT Security-Provider zu einem umfassenden Ganzen. Für unsere Kunden bieten wir mithilfe innovativer Lösungen und Technologien Gesamtkonzepte zur IT Security, die auf den Aspekten Schützen, Erkennen und Abwehren beruhen. Dazu zählen der Einsatz massgeschneiderter Strategien, die Sensibilisierung der Mitarbeitenden sowie weitreichende Servicepakete. Sämtliche Prozesse in Unternehmen werden immer stärker digital vernetzt. Dank aufeinander abgestimmter Maßnahmen und einem mehrschichtigen Schutzsystem sind unsere Kunden für die Zukunft gewappnet. Hilf uns die IT-Sicherheit unserer Kunden zu schützen und werde Teil unserer großartigen Vision mit einem einzigartigen Teamgeist. KONTAKT Bei Fragen kannst Du Dich gerne per Email an ▶ Sina Aboltakhti (Senior Talent Acquisition Partner) wenden.

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer Cisco SD-A
review_candidates.location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
review_candidates.description: Dit bieden wij jou Bij Axians werken we dagelijks aan de netwerken van morgen. Organisaties stellen steeds hogere eisen aan beschikbaarheid, beveiliging en flexibiliteit. Daarom helpen wij onze klanten met moderne, software-defined netwerkoplossingen die klaar zijn voor de toekomst. Binnen onze Business Unit 'Industries & Business Services' werken we samen aan complexe netwerkvraagstukken voor enterprise organisaties en industriële klanten. We combineren diepgaande technische kennis met een pragmatische aanpak en geloven dat de beste oplossingen ontstaan wanneer specialisten samenwerken. Daarnaast bieden we: Een salaris, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring, tussen de € 4.000,- en € 5.200,-; Een winstdeling bij de behaalde bedrijfsdoelstellingen; 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om meer dagen op te bouwen; Premievrij pensioen; Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget; Laptop en telefoon van de zaak; Budget voor jouw thuiswerkplek; Hybride werken; Veel ruimte voor opleidingen en certificeringen; Specialistische collega's om mee te sparren; Een modern Cisco enterprise-landschap; Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Senior Engineer, Consultant of Architect. Hier krijg jij energie van Als Network Engineer Cisco SD-Access werk je aan moderne enterprise netwerken waarin automatisering, security en gebruiksgemak samenkomen. Wij helpen klanten bij de transitie van traditionele netwerken naar software-defined infrastructuren. Daarbij speel jij een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen, implementeren en optimaliseren van Cisco SD-Access omgevingen waarin identity-based networking centraal staat. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten voor organisaties waar continuïteit, schaalbaarheid en beveiliging essentieel zijn. Samen met andere engineers, consultants en architecten realiseer je slimme netwerkoplossingen die gebruikers en apparaten veilig toegang geven tot bedrijfskritische systemen. Wij geven je de ruimte om jouw expertise verder uit te bouwen en ondersteunen je actief in jouw persoonlijke en technische ontwikkeling. Binnen onze teams staan kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier centraal. In deze functie werk je dagelijks aan complexe Cisco enterprise netwerken en software-defined infrastructuren. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Implementeren en optimaliseren van Cisco SD-Access omgevingen; Configureren van Cisco ISE en Network Access Control-oplossingen; Implementeren van 802.1X, TrustSec en Zero Trust-principes; Ontwerpen en beheren van identity-based netwerksegmentatie; Uitvoeren van migraties naar software-defined netwerken; Troubleshooten van complexe networking- en securityvraagstukken; Samenwerken met consultants, architects en andere engineers. Je werkt niet alleen reactief aan incidenten, maar juist ook proactief aan verbeteringen en vernieuwing van de netwerkomgevingen waar je verantwoordelijk voor bent. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent een engineer die energie krijgt van complexe enterprise netwerken en graag werkt met de nieuwste Cisco-technologieën. Je vindt het leuk om technische uitdagingen op te lossen en continu nieuwe kennis op te doen. Je hebt bijvoorbeeld ervaring als: Network Engineer; Cisco Network Engineer; Cisco SD-Access Engineer; Cisco ISE Engineer; Network Security Engineer; Infrastructure Engineer; Connectivity Engineer. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met: Cisco SD-Access; Cisco ISE; Network Access Control (NAC); 802.1X; Identity Based Networking; Routing & Switching; Enterprise netwerkbeheer; Software Defined Networking. Certificeringen zoals CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, Cisco SD-Access Specialist of vergelijkbaar zijn een sterke pre. Dit is jouw team Bij Axians helpen we organisaties met het ontwikkelen van veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige netwerken. De eisen aan IT-infrastructuren worden steeds hoger door cloud, hybride werken, IoT en digitalisering. Daarom ontwerpen en beheren wij moderne netwerkomgevingen die klaar zijn voor de uitdagingen van morgen. Als onderdeel van VINCI Energies combineren we de slagkracht van een internationale organisatie met de betrokkenheid van gespecialiseerde lokale teams. Binnen onze netwerkspecialisatie werken consultants, architects en engineers dagelijks samen aan innovatieve netwerkoplossingen voor klanten door heel Nederland. We geloven in kennisdeling, ondernemerschap en vertrouwen. Daarom krijg je veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen, jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan de netwerken van de toekomst. Binnen Enterprise Networks helpen wij organisaties met het ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van moderne netwerkinfrastructuren. We ondersteunen klanten bij hun digitale transformatie en zorgen ervoor dat hun netwerken veilig, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn. Ons team bestaat uit consultants, architects en engineers met een gezamenlijke passie voor networking en security. We delen actief kennis, helpen elkaar bij complexe vraagstukken en blijven continu investeren in innovatie en ontwikkeling. De lijnen zijn kort, de sfeer is informeel en er is veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Zo combineren we de warmte van een hecht team met de mogelijkheden van een internationale organisatie. Samen bouwen we aan de enterprise netwerken van morgen.

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Network Engineer Job Category: Information Technology Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI Employee Type: Regular-Long Term Assignment Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Local * * * The Opportunity Are you interested in continuing your career in Europe in a mission focused environment? CACI has established upcoming positions throughout the European theater supporting multiple customers for the Department of Defense. We are looking for experienced, innovative and motivated IT Specialists to support enablement EUCOM’s mission objectives. Responsibilities CACI has an excellent opportunity for an experienced, self-directed, Network Engineer . This position is in support of a Department of Defense (DoD) organization, US EUCOM located OCONUS in Stuttgart, Germany. This position is requires OCONUS travel. This position is a unique Network Engineer position which gives the candidate the opportunity to engineer, build, operate and maintain several enterprise networks from the end-user device all the way through the network security stack to the include the data center infrastructure. The Network Engineer must have extensive experience and technical knowledge of both Enterprise and Data Center networks in addition to network security technologies. This position is a hands-on technical position that provides technical expertise and leadership for enterprise network infrastructure at customer sites. The Network Engineer will work in dynamic fast paced environments that require team interaction and synchronization of efforts across several projects. The candidate must interface with both internal and external executive leadership. The Network Engineer works with a team of network engineers, system administrators and voice engineers in support of several geographically dispersed regional networks. The selected candidate will ensure the maintenance of multiple network enclaves, consisting primarily of Cisco routers, switches, and firewalls with support for other vendor products (e.g. KLAS, DTech, F5 etc.). The Network Engineer will design complex routing and switching schemes. The Network Engineer must have extensive experience working with DMVPN technologies, EIGRP, BGP and emerging data center architectures in addition to experience with network automation technologies. The Network Engineer is expected to troubleshoot complex problems to closure; the candidate must demonstrate strength in this area as part of the selection process. The Network Engineer will be responsible for maintaining, analyzing, troubleshooting, repairing and supporting all switching and routing devices, firewalls, load balancers, and in-line network encryption devices. The Network engineer must have a fundamental understanding of network engineering concepts and be able to adapt to emerging technologies as they are introduced to the environment. The Network Engineer must configure devices in accordance with security policies; develop and maintain IP address schemes for all assigned network; and manage circuit provisioning throughout the delivery life cycle. The Network Engineer must monitor capacity and utilization of network resources; provide trending and capacity planning services to analyze and plan for efficient utilization and management of the network. Troubleshoot and correct all detected or reported network faults or outages. Provide assistance via remote access, phone, or in person. The selected candidate will perform site surveys, configuration and engineering, installation planning and documentation services for the customer as they relate to all network services. They will be responsible for analyzing network protocols, routing standards and procedures, traffic patterns and data flow, and providing equipment implementation and upgrade recommendations. The successful candidate must be able to communicate clearly and succinctly both written and orally, and present products and ideas in a business-like manner. The candidate will require strong interpersonal skills due to continual interaction with managers, clients, and users with varying technical backgrounds in a fast-paced work environment. EUCOM operates multiple network enclaves, several of which provide critical Command and Control capabilities globally. EUCOM is looking to rapidly expand their network footprint and capacity. As part of this renewal, the command will introduce emerging technologies to manage, build, operate and maintain the infrastructure providing the candidate an unprecedented opportunity to grow their skills, be part of change that will shape how future DoD networks will be built, and see immediate results from their contributions. The candidate will be expected to operate in a complex environment with multiple different organizations providing various aspects of service delivery to the customer. The candidate must be comfortable looking at problems from different angles to determine potential root causes, develop strategies to test your theories, and then effectively communicate that to other service providers. Qualifications Required: Currently hold an adjudicated Top Secret /SCI Clearance and be able to maintain BA/BS + 3 years recent specialized or AA/AS +7 years recent specialized or a major cert + 7 years recent specialized or 11 years of recent specialized experience Extensive operational experience maintaining network infrastructure Knowledge in Microsoft Office Suite products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) DoD IAT Level II or greater Cisco Certified Network Professional as minimum Computing Environment Certification Enterprise level experience designing, engineering, operating and maintaining network security infrastructures These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have ITIL v3 – Foundation Understanding of Department of Defense Military standards Experience with DoD IT security requirements Experience managing metrics supporting Critical Success Factors (CSF) What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $82,700 - 173,900 USD CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

About The Role We’re hiring an experienced SEO Performance Manager to lead the performance of a group of sites. You’ll choose priorities and take ideas from investigation through implementation and results, with data, developer and content support behind you. There are no clients or accounts, so decisions stay close to the work and good ideas can move quickly. The role can be fully remote with good overlap with European working hours, or hybrid from our Balluta Bay office in Malta, right on the water, with panoramic sea views and a full-size private gym. What You’ll Do Lead SEO performance across assigned sites, from strategy and prioritisation through implementation and follow-up. Choose priorities based on the size of the opportunity, likely impact, effort and risk. Lead keyword strategy, site architecture, internal linking and on-page optimisation. Investigate problems involving crawling, indexing, templates, architecture and internal linking. Improve existing pages and decide where new pages, sections or launches are worth the effort. Turn ideas into tests, involve the right developers and content specialists, and remain close to the work until it is live and measured. Monitor rankings, traffic, conversion and revenue, investigate unexpected changes and adjust the plan when results move in the wrong direction. Use AI to improve research, analysis, implementation and quality checks while remaining responsible for the final decision and output. Share useful methods and give feedback to more junior SEOs as the role develops. What We’re Looking For At least three years of hands-on SEO, ideally in iGaming, affiliate or another competitive search market. Examples of choosing between competing SEO opportunities when time or resources were limited. Experience diagnosing a meaningful traffic or ranking problem and identifying the underlying cause. At least one test or improvement that you took from an initial idea through implementation and measurement. A clear understanding of how rankings, traffic, conversion and revenue relate to one another. A solid technical SEO foundation, including crawling, indexing, architecture, internal linking and on-page optimisation. Confident using Google Search Console, analytics, crawling and backlink tools to investigate performance and make decisions. We care about what you can determine with the tools, not which brand you have used. Experience working directly with developers on technical changes. Comfortable using AI in practical SEO work, or able to learn new technical tools quickly. Based in Malta on a hybrid schedule, or fully remote with good overlap with European working hours. Useful, But Not Essential Experience with WordPress, large websites or site migrations. Experience improving conversion as well as rankings and traffic. Experience guiding junior colleagues or working with external specialists. Basic HTML, CSS, SQL or scripting skills. What Success Looks Like After Six Months You have a clear plan for your sites, have shipped several meaningful improvements and have shown that you can choose priorities, learn from results and change course when the evidence requires it. Why join Paradise Media Have room to test ideas, with data, developer and content support available to get useful work live. Work with experienced SEOs who compare approaches and share what they learn. Stay close to implementation and see the relationship between your decisions and the results. Help improve how the SEO team uses AI in day-to-day work. Receive a competitive salary and 27 days of paid annual leave, plus public holidays. Work fully remote or from our Malta office. The office has a full-size gym, personal trainers, Secretlab gaming chairs, 49-inch monitors, fresh fruit and vegetables, and the sea outside the window. How To Apply If you want room to make decisions, test ideas and stay close to the results, we would like to hear from you. When you apply, tell us about one SEO decision or test you personally took from idea through implementation and measurement.

Structure and negotiate underwriting terms, collateral requirements, indemnity agreements, and other risk mitigation measures. Determine appropriate capacity, pricing, and terms for new and renewal business. Monitor portfolio performance and take corrective action as necessary to achieve profitability objectives. Participate in large account reviews and referral discussions. Maintain underwriting quality and adherence to company guidelines and authority levels. Marketing and Business Development Develop and execute regional marketing and production plans. Build and strengthen relationships with retail and wholesale surety brokers. Identify and develop new business opportunities consistent with company risk appetite. Conduct regular agency visits and joint sales calls. Represent the company at industry events, agency meetings, conferences, and association functions. Drive submission flow and increase market visibility throughout the territory. Establish agency business plans and monitor production goals. Maintain strong relationships with key distribution partners and strategic accounts. Monitor premium volume, loss ratio, expense ratio, and collection objectives. Conduct periodic book reviews to identify trends, opportunities, and emerging risks. review_candidates.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against. Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery. Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back. Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness. Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record. Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears. Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. What you'll need Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers. Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify. Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control). AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all. Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience. Outcomes Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland .   Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.   Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round   For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing our compensation programs and policies in the region in the context of our global frameworks and philosophy. This includes providing guidance on compensation-related issues for business partners and the People Team, interpreting salary data, and performing analysis to ensure compliance and competitive positioning within the marketplace. If you are a creative game-changer and committed team player, this career move is for you. As a People Team, we are responsible for fostering a great workplace and culture that empowers everyone to do their best work. You will work closely with different teams and partner on various initiatives of the business with a particular focus on collaboration with our global compensation and benefits team to ensure best practices and employee engagement as Vialto continues its rapid growth. We believe in supporting our employees throughout their journey with Vialto and are looking for a new colleague who understands the value of employee-focused and tailored solutions. Key Responsibilities Strategic Partnership Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and regional executives on compensation strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market competitiveness Collaborate with Executive Leaders, Business Partners, Performance Management and Talent Acquisition teams to ensure effective use of compensation data and alignment with organizational goals. Co-lead annual pay planning, market analysis, and special projects for the region and global initiatives. Educate leaders and managers on compensation philosophy, policies, and compliance requirements to foster transparency and trust. Compensation Program Management Support global compensation programs, including base pay, incentive, and equity programs. Conduct job evaluations and market pricing analyses across multiple functions and countries to ensure internal equity and external competitiveness. Manage end-to-end delivery of compensation-related projects, including annual pay cycles, market benchmarking, and compliance initiatives. Coordinate timelines, resources, and stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones to ensure successful execution. Develop tools, templates, and guidelines to ensure smooth execution and compliance and pay planning across multiple countries. Identify opportunities to enhance compensation programs through automation, technology, and innovative practices. Sales Plan Design Partner with leadership to design and implement competitive sales compensation plans that align with business objectives. Develop competitive and motivating sales incentive structures that align with business objectives and drive revenue growth. Partner with Finance to build analytical models to simulate various compensation scenarios, ensuring cost-effectiveness and sustainability. Ensure plans are compliant with local regulations and harmonized with global frameworks. Data Analysis & Reporting Conduct market pricing analyses across different functions and countries to ensure internal equity, external competitiveness, and alignment to the company’s global compensation philosophy. Interpret salary data and develop analytical models and templates for compensation projects. Create and deliver detailed reports and dashboards to inform decision-making at all levels. Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to executive leadership and People Team Compliance & Governance Ensure adherence to local regulatory/statutory requirements and global compensation philosophy. Drive compliance with EU gender pay gap directives and other regional regulations Partner and/or lead regional and global compensation projects as needed. Qualifications Minimum of 6-8 years of increasing accountability and success in the areas of compensation design, analyses, education, and socialization of rewards programs in a high-growth, go-to-market, high-tech, global organization. Passion and inspired by data storytelling with strong analytics expertise with high proficiency in MS Office environment (Excel, docs, power point), Google environment, and Workday. Proven ability to create reports, design sales plans, project management, and present insights to executive leadership. Ability to demonstrate integrity and maintain confidentiality. Nimble, quick learner and an independent, proactive working style and curious - able to work with limited direction. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment in which decisions are made collaboratively and within a high-performing, engaging team at all levels and across multiple time zones. Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated success working with all levels of an organization. Experience with interpretation and applying local regulatory/statutory requirements for compensation. Preferred experience in acquisition-driven program harmonization on compensation. Required to be fluent in English with excellent presentation, written and spoken communication. Company Description Vialto Partners is a market leader in Global Mobility Services. Our purpose is to “Connect the World.” We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues. Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work. Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8,000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. review_candidates.description: Business Unit: Cubic Defense Company Details: When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com. Job Details: Job Summary: The Delivery Team Member will act as the LVC team customer interface at each delivery location. Duties include preparation of equipment before being deployed, training and issuing synthetic wrap equipment to users, liaising with the customer staff at each delivery location and monitoring the performance of synthetic wrap once in use. Additionally, the Delivery Team Member should be prepared to act as a role player in those instances that the customer cannot supply staff, where possible according to subject matter expertise. Finally, at the end of any delivery the Delivery Team Member is to assist in recovering equipment, including carrying out functional checks for damage and misuse, and then return it to the requisite stores securely. Delivery Team Members are expected to be computer literate and able to interrogate user access devices in order to perform 1st line fault finding and rectification. All interaction with CDUK’s accredited simulation networks are to conform to SCOPIC 2 SyOps. Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Team Duties. The Delivery Team Member will conform to shift rosters, any allocation of the schedule of work and interact with the customer and their users in accordance with the directions given by the Delivery Team Leader. Hours of work. Your standard working week will be 37.5 hours, unless otherwise specified in special conditions. Your core hours will be directed by your line manager. During exercise periods there will be a surge of activity which cannot be interrupted and you are therefore expected to work the hours necessary to fulfil the requirements of the contract (and your role). Subject to operational requirements, excess hours worked during exercise periods will be accounted for with compensatory rest/time off in lieu (which you should clear with your line manager and the operations’ manager). Training Delivery. The Delivery Team Member will ensure that users are trained to operate CDUK LVC capabilities and equipment according to role, as directed. You are to be familiar with all CDUK synthetic wrap capabilities and are expected to be able to train and issue, stimulate for exercise purposes, fault-find and brief on all capabilities as necessary. Customer Liaison. Delivery Teams are small, so the Delivery Team Member is to be prepared to attend any briefings and exercise planning meetings that fall within a shift, as directed by the Delivery Team Leader. Delivery Modification. The Delivery Team Member is to modify delivery as directed, within software, hardware and personnel resource limits, in order to provide the customer with the most effective training experience possible. SQEP and Competency/Currency. The Delivery Team Member is to ensure that they team deploy ready and capable of providing service delivery in line with subject matter expertise roles. Comply with Cubic’s values and adherence to all company policy and procedures. In particular comply with the code of conduct, quality, security and occupational health, safety and environmental policies and procedures. In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed, the job holder is required to perform other duties assigned by their manager from time-to-time, as may be reasonably required of them. Minimum Job Requirements: Prior employment in a training role. Prior employment in a simulation role, and proven experience working with simulation systems. Education and qualifications: Graduate of a Non-Commissioned Officer course, or equivalent service/national course. Graduate of military vocational technical course, or equivalent military engineering technical awareness course. Working conditions: In general terms, the role is one that requires the appointee to travel to deliver. The nature of CDUK LVC Team operations are such that ‘working in the field’ will occasionally be necessary and the Delivery Team Member must be prepared to do long working hours during this time. Once training and issue to users is complete (which by necessity is often outside), monitoring of in-use systems takes place from within a building. When not delivering, your place of work will be at a Cubic facility. Working outside of normal hours (including weekends) is expected based on opportunities and the delivery schedule. In addition, the Delivery Team Member must be able to work while travelling, globally. Resilient and willing to work outdoors on occasions. Ability to build excellent relationships within a team, yet also able to self-motivate. Excellent communication skills. The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need. ‎ Worker Type: Employee ‎ We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.

new_matches.description: We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer in Ireland, UK, Spain, or Portugal in a hybrid or remote basis. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location. We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices. We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey! At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. What You Will Do Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS). Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD. Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR). Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers. Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance. Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers. Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs. Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms. Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms. Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code. Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs. Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs. Understanding of mobile GPU architecture (tiling, bandwidth, power constraints). Proficiency in GPU performance profiling and optimization workflows. Familiarity with compute-based rendering techniques, GPU-driven pipelines, and modern culling/visibility approaches. Bonus Points Experience with UE5’s Nanite/Lumen or equivalent advanced rendering solutions. Background in custom engine development or low-level rendering systems. Contributions to open-source graphics tools or technical publications. Cross-platform rendering experience beyond mobile (PC/console). About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. new_matches.title: SEO Performance Manager
new_matches.description: Paradise Media is a privately owned media company with a global portfolio of sports and iGaming brands. About The Role We’re hiring an experienced SEO Performance Manager to lead the performance of a group of sites. You’ll choose priorities and take ideas from investigation through implementation and results, with data, developer and content support behind you. There are no clients or accounts, so decisions stay close to the work and good ideas can move quickly. The role can be fully remote with good overlap with European working hours, or hybrid from our Balluta Bay office in Malta, right on the water, with panoramic sea views and a full-size private gym. What You’ll Do Lead SEO performance across assigned sites, from strategy and prioritisation through implementation and follow-up. Choose priorities based on the size of the opportunity, likely impact, effort and risk. Lead keyword strategy, site architecture, internal linking and on-page optimisation. Investigate problems involving crawling, indexing, templates, architecture and internal linking. Improve existing pages and decide where new pages, sections or launches are worth the effort. Turn ideas into tests, involve the right developers and content specialists, and remain close to the work until it is live and measured. Monitor rankings, traffic, conversion and revenue, investigate unexpected changes and adjust the plan when results move in the wrong direction. Use AI to improve research, analysis, implementation and quality checks while remaining responsible for the final decision and output. Share useful methods and give feedback to more junior SEOs as the role develops. What We’re Looking For At least three years of hands-on SEO, ideally in iGaming, affiliate or another competitive search market. Examples of choosing between competing SEO opportunities when time or resources were limited. Experience diagnosing a meaningful traffic or ranking problem and identifying the underlying cause. At least one test or improvement that you took from an initial idea through implementation and measurement. A clear understanding of how rankings, traffic, conversion and revenue relate to one another. A solid technical SEO foundation, including crawling, indexing, architecture, internal linking and on-page optimisation. Confident using Google Search Console, analytics, crawling and backlink tools to investigate performance and make decisions. We care about what you can determine with the tools, not which brand you have used. Experience working directly with developers on technical changes. Comfortable using AI in practical SEO work, or able to learn new technical tools quickly. Based in Malta on a hybrid schedule, or fully remote with good overlap with European working hours. Useful, But Not Essential Experience with WordPress, large websites or site migrations. Experience improving conversion as well as rankings and traffic. Experience guiding junior colleagues or working with external specialists. Basic HTML, CSS, SQL or scripting skills. What Success Looks Like After Six Months You have a clear plan for your sites, have shipped several meaningful improvements and have shown that you can choose priorities, learn from results and change course when the evidence requires it. Why join Paradise Media Have room to test ideas, with data, developer and content support available to get useful work live. Work with experienced SEOs who compare approaches and share what they learn. Stay close to implementation and see the relationship between your decisions and the results. Help improve how the SEO team uses AI in day-to-day work. Receive a competitive salary and 27 days of paid annual leave, plus public holidays. Work fully remote or from our Malta office. The office has a full-size gym, personal trainers, Secretlab gaming chairs, 49-inch monitors, fresh fruit and vegetables, and the sea outside the window. How To Apply If you want room to make decisions, test ideas and stay close to the results, we would like to hear from you. When you apply, tell us about one SEO decision or test you personally took from idea through implementation and measurement.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against. Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery. Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back. Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness. Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record. Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears. Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. What you'll need Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers. Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify. Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control). AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all. Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience. Outcomes Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland .   Language English is our main working language across global teams. CEO / final round   For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

During exercise periods there will be a surge of activity which cannot be interrupted and you are therefore expected to work the hours necessary to fulfil the requirements of the contract (and your role). Subject to operational requirements, excess hours worked during exercise periods will be accounted for with compensatory rest/time off in lieu (which you should clear with your line manager and the operations’ manager). Training Delivery. The Delivery Team Member will ensure that users are trained to operate CDUK LVC capabilities and equipment according to role, as directed. You are to be familiar with all CDUK synthetic wrap capabilities and are expected to be able to train and issue, stimulate for exercise purposes, fault-find and brief on all capabilities as necessary. Customer Liaison. Delivery Teams are small, so the Delivery Team Member is to be prepared to attend any briefings and exercise planning meetings that fall within a shift, as directed by the Delivery Team Leader. Delivery Modification. The Delivery Team Member is to modify delivery as directed, within software, hardware and personnel resource limits, in order to provide the customer with the most effective training experience possible. SQEP and Competency/Currency. The Delivery Team Member is to ensure that they team deploy ready and capable of providing service delivery in line with subject matter expertise roles. In particular comply with the code of conduct, quality, security and occupational health, safety and environmental policies and procedures. In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed, the job holder is required to perform other duties assigned by their manager from time-to-time, as may be reasonably required of them. Minimum Job Requirements: Prior employment in a training role. Prior employment in a simulation role, and proven experience working with simulation systems. Education and qualifications: Graduate of a Non-Commissioned Officer course, or equivalent service/national course. Graduate of military vocational technical course, or equivalent military engineering technical awareness course. Working conditions: In general terms, the role is one that requires the appointee to travel to deliver. The nature of CDUK LVC Team operations are such that ‘working in the field’ will occasionally be necessary and the Delivery Team Member must be prepared to do long working hours during this time. Once training and issue to users is complete (which by necessity is often outside), monitoring of in-use systems takes place from within a building. When not delivering, your place of work will be at a Cubic facility. Working outside of normal hours (including weekends) is expected based on opportunities and the delivery schedule. Ability to build excellent relationships within a team, yet also able to self-motivate. Excellent communication skills. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software engineer, control plane & orchestration experience. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Demonstrated experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems. Proven experience developing platform APIs that are consumed by multiple internal or external engineering teams. Strong experience designing RESTful APIs with emphasis on reliability, consistency, idempotency, and versioning. Demonstrated experience building event-driven or message-driven architectures. Strong understanding of asynchronous workflows, orchestration patterns, and distributed coordination. Proven experience designing highly available backend services. Strong expertise with Kubernetes, including Operators, Controllers, and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs). Demonstrated experience managing multi-tenant Kubernetes environments. Experience deploying and operating cloud-native applications in production. Proven experience designing storage solutions utilizing object, file, block, or container storage. Strong understanding of distributed system consistency models, fault tolerance, and failure recovery. Practical experience implementing observability using metrics, logging, tracing, and monitoring solutions. Experience collaborating closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions. Solid background working with GitOps deployment methodologies. Deep experience working with air-gapped or highly regulated Kubernetes environments. Hands-on experience building orchestration platforms for distributed infrastructure. Solid understanding of networking infrastructure, service meshes, or proxy architectures. Familiarity with multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments. Experience building internal developer platforms or platform engineering solutions. Knowledge of cloud-native storage technologies. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Nice To Have We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity. Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI. Work Authorization Requirements Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future. What We Offer Competitive pay. 100% remote work. The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. Continuing education opportunities. Opportunity to grow and expand your career.
